CommunityApplications.Profile: isputnik.games adds family games to isputnik.home, the private self-hosted family media library: Dots, Star Battle, Chess, Dominoes and Checkers, played two on one screen, against the computer, or online between family members, and the arcade games Sputnik Catch and Torpedo Run. It is an add-on container with no sign-in of its own: install it beside the isputnik container, pair the two on isputnik.home's Settings, Apps page, and the games open inside isputnik.home. Report problems and ask questions on GitHub issues.
